name: 武道館と陸上競技場の利用料金表を改定
summary: 武道館と陸上競技場では、施設や備品の利用料金の上限額が条例で定められています。この議案で上限額の表を改めます。たとえば、武道館の大人の個人利用は市内270円、市外540円、陸上競技場の全日貸切りは市内団体24,330円、市外団体48,660円とし、令和10年1月1日以後の利用に適用します。
changes: 武道館の施設利用料金の上限額を、利用時間や市内外・営利利用の区分ごとに改める
武道館の放送設備利用料金の上限額を、市内外・営利利用の区分ごとに改める
陸上競技場の施設利用料金の上限額を、施設や利用時間、市内外・営利利用の区分ごとに改める
陸上競技場の備品利用料金の上限額を、市内外・営利利用の区分ごとに改める
who: 武道館や陸上競技場を利用する個人・団体

en.name: Revises fee schedules for the martial arts hall and athletics stadium
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Management and Operation of Tama City Martial Arts Hall and Tama City Athletics Stadium
en.summary: The ordinance sets maximum fees for using the facilities and equipment at the martial arts hall and athletics stadium. This bill revises the tables of maximum fees. For example, individual use of the martial arts hall by an adult will cost ¥270 for users from within the city and ¥540 for users from outside the city. An all-day exclusive rental of the athletics stadium will cost ¥24,330 for a group from within the city and ¥48,660 for a group from outside the city. The revised fees will apply to use on or after January 1, 2028.
changes: Revises the maximum facility-use fees at the martial arts hall by usage time and by whether users are from within or outside the city and whether the use is for profit
Revises the maximum fees for using broadcasting equipment at the martial arts hall by whether users are from within or outside the city and whether the use is for profit
Revises the maximum facility-use fees at the athletics stadium by facility, usage time, and whether users are from within or outside the city and whether the use is for profit
Revises the maximum fees for using equipment at the athletics stadium by whether users are from within or outside the city and whether the use is for profit
who: Individuals using the martial arts hall
Groups using the martial arts hall
